title: DESQ: Dynamic-Flooding Transformer Ensembles for Reinforcement-Learning-Based Equity Market Timing (v1.2-desq)
description: Reference implementation for the revised IEEE Access paper. This v1.2-desq release aligns to the complete 28-page authority, adds deterministic per-stock nine-seed median-agent selection, updates Appendix A1/C1 artifacts, separates Appendix F alarms from repository-defined update policy, and presents only current-paper result tables in the active documentation.
